result.note: Tests the Zojila Tunnel breakthrough, its all-weather Ladakh access and the route's Kargil war link.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Zojila Tunnel:
items: It achieved its main breakthrough in June 2026.
It is intended to provide all-weather access to Ladakh.
It lies along a strategic frontier route that Pakistan targeted during the 1999 Kargil war.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. The tunnel's main breakthrough came on Wednesday, 10 June 2026, and it promises all-weather access to Ladakh along a frontier route Pakistan targeted in the 1999 Kargil war.
questions.source: The Zojila Tunnel achieved its main breakthrough, promising all-weather access to Ladakh along a strategic frontier route Pakistan targeted during the 1999 Kargil war.
